panel_description_zh: 近景平视，李斌坐在客厅或玄关旁，脸是 3/4 侧面；眼睛半睁目光望向中景的墙（不看妻子）；眉头平（无语特征）；嘴闭紧；他的手正在帮忙扣扣子（动作模糊化重点）；妻子不在画面内但读者知道他在配合。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 你赶快下去吧，人滴滴司机等你多长时间了？每次都这样。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium close-up on a 30-something East Asian Chinese man seated near the entryway, shot from the wife's perspective looking down at him as she stands at the door. Speechless exasperated expression — eyes half-lidded with slightly unfocused gaze looking past the camera at a middle-distance point on the wall (not making eye contact), eyebrows flat and expressionless neither raised nor furrowed, mouth closed with lips pressed together and a tiny breath between them, slight asymmetry with the left corner a millimeter lower than the right, head level facing forward but eyes off-target. Two-to-three-day stubble shadow visible, dark circles under the eyes, short black slightly messy side-swept hair. One hand is doing the small busywork of helping fasten a button on the wife's jacket (the wife is off-frame behind the camera). Wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt and navy blue plaid pajama pants. Flat ambient room light with no strong shadows. Mood: the silent helper, the resignation of doing a small task while the bigger argument hovers unspoken. Text watermark 'P06-PN06' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, open mouth as if speaking, eye-roll visible, sigh lines, hands balled into fists, wife visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, soft romantic mood
